newsitem.title: FRANCE: French industry chiefs see mediocre outlook.
newsitem.headline: French industry chiefs see mediocre outlook.

text.p: National statistics institute INSEE gave the following seasonally adjusted data.
A positive figure shows the percentage points by which the percentage of respondents saying things had improved or risen outnumbered the percentage saying things had worsened.
Sep Jul Jun May Apr Mar Feb
Note: An INSEE spokeswoman said no survey was conducted in August.

The latest survey showed the overall outlook of corporate chiefs for business in general was mediocre while their personal outlook was little changed and suggested slight growth in production in the months ahead.
The general outlook for prices shows expectations of a significant drop in prices while the personal outlook for prices rebounded after declining sharply in June.
For semi-finished goods, the outlook is "pretty well oriented" and production should rise in the months ahead, the survey found.
In the months ahead, production of capital equipment should also rise. Consumer goods production should rise slightly.
In the car and land-transport sector, activity is likely to increase while remaining at a subdued level, the survey found.
